en: Sepia-toned interior view of an early 20th‑century European café or coffeehouse. The foreground shows small round tables with bentwood chairs, a piano with several soda or syrup dispensers mounted above it, and wood-paneled booths along the right side. The back of the room is visible through an arched opening with curtains, leading to another seating area. The walls are decorated with patterned wallpaper, framed oval pictures, and a portrait of a man above the arch. Lighting consists of simple ceiling fixtures and daylight from a window on the right. The image has the look of a promotional photograph printed as a postcard.
